title: Indefatigable
summary: INDEFAT'IGABLE, adjective [Latin indefatigabilis; in and defatigo, fatigo, to fatigue.] Unwearied; not tired; not exhausted by labor; not yielding to fatigue; as indefatigable exertions; indefatigable

inlines.v: INDEFAT'IGABLE, adjective [Latin indefatigabilis; in and defatigo, fatigo, to fatigue.] Unwearied; not tired; not exhausted by labor; not yielding to fatigue; as indefatigable exertions; indefatigable attendance or perseverance. Upborne with indefatigable wings.
